Each local panel faithfully ports its web sibling's data semantics, null-safety, i18n keys, and value math: Powertrain (shift-state chip colours D/R/N, center-anchored power bar +/-300 via percentage DimensionValue, RPM/torque MetricTiles, peak motor temp >80 red, regen kW), Climate (cabin/outside temps, setpoints, HVAC, 6-bar fan meter vs fan_status, defrost/climate/precondition chips), Security (hasData = securityData!=null||remoteStartEnabled!=null, lock SemanticIcon box, sentry/doors/windows/user-present, detail, remote-start), VehicleState (raw English labels + live.* unknown casts exactly as web, sseConnected 'Live' tag, dividers, speedLimit via formatSpeed), TirePressure (Pa thresholds + paToKpa->formatPressure, per-tire colour/border, all-normal/attention/check chip), EnergyCharging (charger V/A MetricTiles; charger_power_w + 'kW' and charge_energy_added_wh + 'kWh' suffixes and range_added_meters_per_hour/3600 through formatSpeed are preserved byte-faithfully including the web unit-suffix quirks), Media&Navigation (cleanNil now-playing, playback chip, destination + convertDistanceFromSI(miles_to_arrival) + unitPrefs.distance + minutes, home/work/favorite emoji chips).

@/hooks/useUnits + @/lib/unitConversion + @/lib/numberFormat + @/lib/cleanNil + vehicle-detail/helpers have no native module, so the exact pieces used are inlined verbatim (SI converters convertDistance/Speed/Temp/PressureFromSI, Intl.NumberFormat formatters formatTemperature/Speed/Pressure with DEFAULT_PRECISION temp=1/speed=0/pressure=1, fmtNumber/fmtInt/fmtWithUnit/safeNumber global precision default 2, cleanNil, TIRE_PRESSURE_PA + paToKpa); unit/locale/precision derived from native useSettings exactly as web useUnits derives them (unit_of_length 'mi', unit_of_temp 'F', unit_of_pressure 'psi', locale, decimal_precision).

lucide-react icons -> shared SemanticIcon for the 7 panel headers + the lock glyph; small purely-decorative per-row icons (Eye/Fan/Door/etc.) are dropped with their text labels preserved (documented parity trade-off). @/components/ui GlassPanel + EmptyState used directly; Badge/MetricCard reproduced as local Chip/MetricTile. Tailwind -> StyleSheet; toned-down chip palette resolved to literals. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles. No DOM, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.
